name.en: Fio Puro Paisley Shirt Dress in Cotton with Long Sleeves, a Button Front, Point Collar and Midi Hem

description.en: A cotton shirt dress in paisley, buttoned from collar to midi hem, with long sleeves you can roll. The self belt marks the waist.
